description.message: Records a tab's sound (Google Meet or any other) and your microphone. Krya makes the transcript on this computer.

commandToggle.message: Start or stop recording the tab

footer.message: The transcript appears in Krya → Transcripts.

noMic.message: Without the microphone: only the others will be in the transcript.

orKey.message: Or Alt+Shift+M on the meeting tab. The tab and your microphone are recorded as two tracks.

startKrya.message: Start Krya and turn on Transcribe: it makes the text on this computer.

micBlocked.message: The microphone is not allowed: your voice will be missing.

lost.message: Part of the recording did not reach Krya

sent.message: Sent. The transcript is ready in a few minutes.

micWhy.message: Krya records your voice as a track of its own, so the transcript shows where you spoke and where the others did. The sound never leaves this computer: Krya transcribes it here.

micDone.message: Done. You can close this tab.

micFailed.message: Did not work: $1. Check that the microphone is allowed in Windows' privacy settings.

errNoSound.message: Chrome did not give the tab's sound: $1
